mapper.select: SELECT d.driver_id AS driverId, d.emp_no AS empNo, e.name, e.phone, d.region_code AS regionCode, r.name AS regionName, d.is_active AS active FROM driver d JOIN employee e ON d.emp_no = e.emp_no JOIN region r ON d.region_code = r.region_code ORDER BY d.driver_id DESC;

SELECT d.driver_id AS driverId, d.emp_no AS empNo, e.name, e.phone, d.region_code AS regionCode, r.name AS regionName, d.is_active AS active FROM driver d JOIN employee e ON d.emp_no = e.emp_no JOIN region r ON d.region_code = r.region_code WHERE d.driver_id = #{driverId};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO driver (emp_no, region_code, is_active) VALUES (#{empNo}, #{regionCode}, #{active});
mapper.update: UPDATE driver SET region_code = #{regionCode}, is_active = #{active} WHERE driver_id = #{driverId};
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dispatch WHERE driver_id = #{driverId};

SELECT v.vehicle_id AS vehicleId, v.region_code AS regionCode, r.name AS regionName, v.plate_number AS plateNumber, v.capacity, v.temp_type AS tempType, v.status, v.is_active AS active FROM vehicle v JOIN region r ON v.region_code = r.region_code ORDER BY v.vehicle_id DESC;

SELECT v.vehicle_id AS vehicleId, v.region_code AS regionCode, r.name AS regionName, v.plate_number AS plateNumber, v.capacity, v.temp_type AS tempType, v.status, v.is_active AS active FROM vehicle v JOIN region r ON v.region_code = r.region_code WHERE v.vehicle_id = #{vehicleId};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vehicle (region_code, plate_number, capacity, temp_type, status, is_active) VALUES (#{regionCode}, #{plateNumber}, #{capacity}, #{tempType}, #{status}, #{active});
mapper.update: UPDATE vehicle SET region_code = #{regionCode}, plate_number = #{plateNumber}, capacity = #{capacity}, temp_type = #{tempType}, status = #{status}, is_active = #{active} WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId};
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dispatch WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId};
